description:
Become knowledgeable on the future of technology through BlueDot Impact's free courses here: https://bluedot.org/pursuitofwonder. Thank you to BlueDot for sponsoring this video.

In this video, we explore the decline of cursive writing, the rise of AI-generative technologies, and the earliest examples of human expression and communication in history. In a world of rapid change and decreasing need for direct human involvement, what do we teach new humans? What do we preserve for future humans?
